description: Submits one Polarion asynchronous job, polls until a terminal state or timeout, then returns `{jobId, status, state, message, logTail}`. Provide the `executeJob` request body with a job factory ID and any factory-specific parameters; job semantics vary by factory. Requires permission to execute that job. Polling cancellation or timeout stops waiting but does not cancel the Polarion job; use `executeJob` and `getJob` separately when you do not need a bounded wait and log tail.

dry_run.description: Return a preview without submitting the job.

log_tail_chars.description: Maximum returned log tail characters; defaults to 4000 and is capped at 20000.

max_wait_seconds.description: Maximum time to poll; defaults to 120 seconds and is capped at 600.

requestBody.description: JSON body passed to `executeJob`; factory-specific parameters vary by jobId.

jobId.description: Polarion job factory ID, such as one listed by the server’s job catalog.

name.description: Optional job name supplied to the selected factory.

nodeId.description: Optional Polarion node ID when the selected factory requires a node scope.

params.description: Optional factory-specific job parameters as a JSON object.

scope.description: Optional scope value interpreted by the selected job factory.

name: run_job_and_wait
title: Run Polarion job and wait
